name: escape-cats
description: Two single-player mini games starring Hex and Goomba

scripts.build:hex: npm run build -w apps/hex-clicker && node scripts/assemble.mjs hex && node scripts/check-routing.mjs hex && npm run check:cursors
scripts.build:goomba: npm run build -w apps/goomba-glider && node scripts/assemble.mjs goomba && node scripts/check-routing.mjs goomba && npm run check:cursors && npm run check:visibility && npm run check:levels
scripts.build:sites: npm run build --workspaces --if-present && node scripts/assemble.mjs && node scripts/check-routing.mjs && npm run check:cursors && npm run check:visibility && npm run check:levels
scripts.test:goomba: node tools/goomba/test-codec.mjs && node tools/goomba/test-library.mjs && node tools/goomba/finale.mjs && npm run check:levels
